title: Tomi House / The Studio
text:
Tomi House / The Studio

Tomi House is built on a 4 × 15.5-meter plot within an existing residential neighborhood in Quy Nhon, Vietnam. Shaped by the constraints of a narrow and deep townhouse, the project brings natural light, ventilation, and everyday family life into the center of the house through its spatial organization.

title: DR House / ARC Architects
text:
DR House / ARC Architects

Located on the north-eastern outskirts of Tashkent, the house sits between two contrasting environments. The site is accessible from two streets, with a canal and gardens on one side and a low-rise residential neighborhood, or mahalla, on the other. The house was positioned to open toward the gardens, while the upper floors offered views of the surrounding landscape and, on clear days, the mountains beyond.

title: Ouse Fashion Lobby / say architects
text:
Ouse Fashion Lobby / say architects

Ouse Fashion is rooted in Hangzhou, with two decades dedicated to one craft: tailoring the warmth of life into clothing. For them, fashion is not merely about appearance — it is about the ease with which one inhabits their daily life. A corporate lobby is the first point of contact between people and a brand. Employees walk in every day and need to feel a sense of purpose in their work. First-time visitors — the materials, the light, the scale — already speak of the brand's taste and standards. Partners step in, and the lobby should emit a signal of an entire aesthetic system.

title: Raw & Warm Residence / Habitat Architects
text:
Raw & Warm Residence / Habitat Architects

Raw & Warm was conceived as a residential laboratory for an art collector—a home where architecture, art, and daily life could coexist without competing for attention. Rather than concealing the original structure, the design preserves the exposed concrete ceiling and its irregular texture, allowing the building's raw character to become the starting point of the spatial narrative.

title: The Threshold House / Madras Spaces
text:
The Threshold House / Madras Spaces

Located in V. Thuraiyur, near Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, this 1000 sq.ft farmhouse by Madras Spaces is conceived as a quiet return to a lost native landscape. Set amidst agricultural fields and far removed from urban noise, the project responds to a tight site, limited resources, and a brief rooted more in memory and belonging than in program.

title: Cuattro Casa de Café / Faci Leboreiro
text:
Cuattro Casa de Café / Faci Leboreiro

At Cuattro Casa de Café, the project did not begin by defining the shape of the building, but rather by establishing what had to remain. Located in Troncones, Guerrero, on a sloping 50-by-24-meter lot just minutes from the sea, the brief brought together a café-restaurant, an artisanal bakery, a Mexican handcrafts shop, and a private office under one determining condition: to preserve all existing vegetation and respond to the tropical climate primarily through passive strategies.

title: Zimbro House / Stemmer Rodrigues Arquitetura
text:
Zimbro House / Stemmer Rodrigues Arquitetura

Casa Zimbro was born from the search for an architecture in continuity with the landscape, where the construction does not impose itself on its surroundings but rather integrates with them in a natural and sensitive way. Sited between the lake and the garden, the house is designed in a light and welcoming manner, shaping itself as a refuge that invites both contemplation and gathering.

title: Nooba Building / Saraiva + Associados
text:
Nooba Building / Saraiva + Associados

Located on the south bank of the Tagus River in Barreiro, Nooba is conceived as a new residential neighborhood shaped by its proximity to the estuary and the profound urban transformation underway in the south bank's former industrial areas. The project occupies a strategic position within a broad process of urban and environmental regeneration, where new public spaces, mobility infrastructure, and ecological corridors redefine the city's relationship with the river. Its planning framework responds to this metropolitan condition by proposing a neighborhood that balances density with openness, positioning housing as the driver of daily urban life and reinforcing continuity with the revitalized waterfront.

title: Zamalanda Park on the Nervión Riverbanks / Burgos & Garrido arquitectos
text:
Zamalanda Park on the Nervión Riverbanks / Burgos & Garrido arquitectos

The area surrounding the Portu Dock in Barakaldo is a vast, empty space that bears the traces of its history. Although blurred, it is a place of great beauty and extraordinary potential, offering splendid views over the Nervión estuary from its upper level and a lush, wild horizontal landscape on its lower level.

title: The Public Kitchen: How Asian Markets Turn Eating Into Civic Life
text:
The Public Kitchen: How Asian Markets Turn Eating Into Civic Life

In many Asian cities, eating has never belonged entirely to the private home. It spills into markets, hawker centers, street stalls, and wholesale districts embedded within larger buildings or areas. These are places where the city exchanges information and watches other people pass through. They are not restaurants in the conventional sense, nor are they simply markets. In some way, their vibrancy and usage reflect the society's conditions at that moment. They are public kitchens: shared infrastructures where domestic routines are partially transferred into collective space.

title: Housing on top of the petrol station / Gut Deubelbeiss Nill Architekten
text:
Housing on top of the petrol station / Gut Deubelbeiss Nill Architekten

The project is situated in Emmenbrücke, a town just outside Lucerne. Set within an industrial and high-traffic environment, the building marks the start of the row of houses by Emmenbrücke railway station. Nestled between the railway tracks and the main road, the ground floor houses a petrol station, while the six stories above provide residential apartments.

title: WeDoctor Green Valley / gad
text:
WeDoctor Green Valley / gad

Located in the Information Port area of Xiaoshan Economic and Technological Development Zone, Hangzhou, WeHealth Green Valley spans four adjacent plots developed as a single unified phase, with a total construction area of approximately 580,000 square meters. Serving as the headquarters for WeHealth Group and a digital health cluster, the project is envisioned as a city-level public vehicle driven by "publicness".

title: Maribyrnong I House / Studio Ceravolo
text:
Maribyrnong I House / Studio Ceravolo

This alterations and additions project to a Californian bungalow welcomes an abundance of natural light and celebrates the passage of time throughout the day. Briefed with renovating and extending a Californian bungalow, we opted to move away from formal expectations and create a project attuned to the present and to the needs of a young family.

title: Achime Bagel Store / JOJOWORKSHOP
text:
Achime Bagel Store / JOJOWORKSHOP

Achime Bagel is a neighborhood bakery located in Munjeong-dong, Seoul. The project began with the idea of creating a small space that could gently accompany the beginning of each day. The bakery prepares and sells its bagels within the same day, and Jojo Workshop sought to translate this simple and diligent attitude into the interior.

title: Hermitage House C70 / ASMD Taller Arquitectura
text:
Hermitage House C70 / ASMD Taller Arquitectura

Ermita C70 transforms a 1960s house in the historic center of Mérida through an operation of subtraction: demolishing part of the built volume to recover the void as a source of light, ventilation, and social life.

title: C.E. House / Dall'Ovo Magalhães Arquitetura
text:
C.E. House / Dall'Ovo Magalhães Arquitetura

A mountain house that blurs the boundaries between living and contemplating. Sited on a plateau, between rolling lawns and the forest that climbs up the slope, the house sits as if it has belonged to the landscape for a long time. The horizontal, discreet, and elongated volume follows the natural slope of the ground — and it is precisely this simple decision that organizes the entire experience of the project: living close to the earth, yet suspended above it.

title: São João Pharmacy / Tsou Arquitectos
text:
São João Pharmacy / Tsou Arquitectos

Form
The building takes on a clear, contained volume, distinguished by the curvilinear form of its façade — a gesture that follows the profile of the street and marks the building's presence on the corner it occupies. This curvature is not merely a plastic device: it is the element that functionally sets the volume apart from the surrounding residential fabric, giving it its own identity without breaking with the scale of the context. The composition is organised over two floors above ground level, complemented by a technical basement, resulting in a compact mass that reads clearly from the street.

title: Breeze House / Ábaton
text:
Breeze House / Ábaton

Breeze House is a new construction project in Madrid that includes the most fundamental aspects of the ABATON philosophy. A modern house framed in nature and light that takes advantage of the characteristics of a plot with great potential to create a house that blends with its exterior.

title: What is Blue Infrastructure? Rethinking Water's Role in City Design
text:
What is Blue Infrastructure? Rethinking Water's Role in City Design

Nature-based solutions are a primary strategy for contemporary climate adaptation and urban ecological resilience, embraced by cities regardless of their geography or climate zone. Green roofs, urban forests, bioswales, expanding tree canopy, protected wetlands, and permeable landscapes are featured prominently in municipal adaptation plans. These interventions are deployed across neighborhoods, distributed through street networks, and measured by hectares restored, trees planted, stormwater retained, or temperatures reduced. This shift expands the role of ecology within cities, establishing environmental elements as infrastructure systems and providing planners with a grounded framework for integrating natural systems into urban development.

title: Antiquity exhibition at Wawel castle / NArchitekTURA
text:
Antiquity exhibition at Wawel castle / NArchitekTURA

The design of the exhibition 'Masterpieces from the Lanckoroński Collection: A Story of Antiquity' is an attempt to introduce unconventional, modern display methods into the historic architecture of Wawel. The concept is based on a stylistically cohesive arrangement of all the rooms, consistent in form but varied in the selection of colours and materials. This, in turn, creates an element of surprise and a gradual progression of impressions.

title: Shanghai Guohua Heyuejia International Senior Living Centre, Continuing Care Retirement Community / GN Architects
text:
Shanghai Guohua Heyuejia International Senior Living Centre, Continuing Care Retirement Community / GN Architects

Guohua Heyuejia International Senior Living Centre is located in Taopu Smart City, Putuo District, Shanghai. The project responds to a long-standing pattern in China's senior living sector, where large, low-density communities have often been developed in suburban locations. Although these projects may offer access to nature, they can also separate older residents from family visits, public services and familiar social networks. Guohua Heyuejia therefore begins with a different proposition: senior living should return to the city and remain connected to everyday urban life.

title: Yaku – Sustainable Urban Runoff Management Module / El Sindicato Arquitectura
text:
Yaku – Sustainable Urban Runoff Management Module / El Sindicato Arquitectura

Isla Tortuga Park, located in northern Quito, Ecuador, was selected for the implementation of the Yaku (meaning "water" in Kichwa) prototype. This modular urban furniture project blends public space with sustainable rainwater and biodiversity management. Designed to be installed on any surface, its objective is to capture rainwater, store it, and promote its infiltration into the ground, emulating the natural water cycle. Yaku invites people to gather in public spaces while raising awareness about the vital relationship between water and the city.

title: MFA House / Simone Jazbik Arquitetura
text:
MFA House / Simone Jazbik Arquitetura

Located in Búzios, Rio de Janeiro, on a 943 m² plot within a gated community, this 348 m² beach house was designed from scratch by @SimoneJazbik.Arq. Designed for a couple in their late 50s—both lawyers—and their two daughters, this is the fourth residence the firm has designed for the family, who are long-time clients. Initially intended for weekends and seasonal rentals, the house has since become central to the owners' routine, as they now split their time between Búzios and Rio de Janeiro.

title: Casa Pura Vida / Zozaya Arquitectos
text:
Casa Pura Vida / Zozaya Arquitectos

Pura Vida was born from the clients' desire to create a unique residence in Troncones: a contemporary home that leverages Mexico's construction qualities, from the richness of its materials to the precision of its artisanal craftsmanship.
